description: This file defines the BpBinder class, a key component in Android's binder IPC mechanism. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to binder proxy management, object handling, and RPC session integration.

classes.name: BpBinder
classes.description: Represents a binder proxy object, managing IPC communication, object lifecycle, and RPC sessions within Android's binder framework.

classes.name: ObjectManager
classes.description: Manages objects attached to the binder, allowing attachment, lookup, detachment, and cleanup.

classes.name: PrivateAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to private members of BpBinder, facilitating creation and retrieval of binder handles and RPC addresses.

classes.name: Obituary
classes.description: Represents death notifications for binder objects, including recipient, cookie, and flags.

methods.name: isRpcBinder
methods.description: Checks if the binder is associated with an RPC session.

methods.name: isBinderAlive
methods.description: Checks if the binder is currently alive.

methods.name: pingBinder
methods.description: Pings the binder to check responsiveness.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps the state of the binder to a file descriptor.

methods.name: linkToDeath
methods.description: Registers a death recipient to be notified if the binder dies.

methods.name: attachObject
methods.description: Attaches an object to the binder with a cleanup function.

methods.name: findObject
methods.description: Finds an attached object by its ID.

methods.name: detachObject
methods.description: Detaches an object by its ID.

methods.name: lookupOrCreateWeak
methods.description: Looks up or creates a weak reference to a binder object.

methods.name: getDebugBinderHandle
methods.description: Returns the debug handle for the binder, if available.

methods.name: startRecordingBinder
methods.description: Begins recording transactions to a file descriptor.
